title: A filtered colimit of henselian pairs is henselian
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a directed set and $(A_\lambda,I_\lambda)_{\lambda\in\Lambda}$ a directed system of pairs: commutative rings $A_\lambda$ with ideals $I_\lambda$ and ring maps $\varphi_{\mu\lambda}:A_\mu\to A_\lambda$ for $\mu\le\lambda$ ($\varphi_{\lambda\lambda}=\mathrm{id}$, $\varphi_{\lambda\nu}\circ\varphi_{\mu\lambda}=\varphi_{\mu\nu}$) with $\varphi_{\mu\lambda}(I_\mu)\subseteq I_\lambda$. Assume every pair $(A_\lambda,I_\lambda)$ is henselian [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology]. Let $A=\varinjlim_\lambda A_\lambda$ be the colimit of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], with coprojections $\alpha_\lambda:A_\lambda\to A$, and $I=\bigcup_\lambda\alpha_\lambda(I_\lambda)$. Then $I$ is an ideal of $A$ contained in the Jacobson radical of $A$, and $(A,I)$ is a henselian pair.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0FWT (lemma-filtered-colimits-henselian, line 2885) and its proof (radical: $u\in1+I$ comes from $u_\lambda\in1+I_\lambda$, a unit by Algebra Lemma lemma-contained-in-radical; henselian: Stacks' Definition Tag 09XE (definition-henselian-pair, lifting of coprime monic factorizations), descending $f,g_0,h_0,g_0',h_0'$ to a stage). Stacks' definition is the factorization form 09XE while [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] is the idempotent form (09XI (3)), so the split of this node either passes through Lemma Tag 09XI (lemma-characterize-henselian-pair) or proves the idempotent form directly; Example Tag 0FWU (example-moret-bailly) shows filteredness is needed
